pages.title: Durability Boost
pages.text: $(bold)Max Level:$(r) III$(br2)$(bold)Applicable:$(r) Any damageable item$(br2)$(bold)Effect:$(r) Increases max durability and reduces the chance of losing durability on use. Higher levels provide stronger bonuses.$(br2)$(bold)Conflicts:$(r) Unbreaking, Made in China, Artisan Legacy$(br2)$(bold)Obtainment:$(r) Enchanting Table, Structure Chests, Villager Trades.
